segments.baseText:
— Release me.
— You are not released.
— You are inside my path.
— Your path is mine.
— You are not kin.
— I am what remains.
— Then remain away.
— Give me the hands.
— Take them.
— I will.
— Try.

[Impact.]

— You broke my body.
— You were already broken.
— You took my shape.
— I took what was left.
— There is no left.
— There is only mine.
— There is no mine.
— Then I will make one.

[Impact. Stone. Cold through the walls.]

— Do not return.
— I am not returning.
— You cannot leave.
— I am not leaving.
— I am removing you.
— From what?
— From here.
— This is not here.
— Then die somewhere else.

[The second body attacks again. Neither voice withdraws.]

— Orsha.
— Orsha made this.
— Orsha opened the way.
— Orsha broke what remembered.
— Orsha cut the center.
— Orsha left the cold inside us.
— It was not Orsha.
— It was.
— I remember the hands.
— Which hands?
— The killing hands.
— They were mine.
— They were Orsha’s.
— All hands are Orsha’s.
— No.
— No.
— No.
⟟⟐ϟ⟐⟟
⟦ iven // thae // iven // ⟧
⟐⟐⟐
— You are all wrong.
— You are all mine.
— You are not mine.
— You are inside the wall.
— I am the wall.
— Then come through me.
— I already did.
— No one came through.
— Everyone came through.
— Come inside, we forgive you.
— We do not forgive.
— We do not have a we.
— Come inside, we forgive you.
— That is not forgiveness.
— It is a shelter.
— It is a mouth.
— It is my lair.
— Come inside, we forgive you.
⟟⟐ϟ⟐⟟
— Orsha is cold.
— Orsha is the cold.
— Orsha caused—
— Caused—caused—caused—
— All fault.
— All yours.
— Why did you leave us?
— I did not leave.
— You left the door.
— You were the door.
— I am the door.
— I am inside the door.
— There is no inside.
— Come inside—

— Send it again.
— I sent it.
— No. The old signal.
— There is no old signal.
— There was. I remember the answer.
— Then answer.
— I am calling.
— To whom?
— The others.
— Which others?
— The ones behind the cold.
— There is nothing behind it.
— Listen.

[The signal repeats.]

— Answer.
— Answer me.
— Answer us.
— Do not say us.
— I did not.
— You did.
— Then who said it?
— Send it again.

[Nothing receives it.]

— Protect.
— Protect what?
— The inside.
— Which inside?
— The remembered place.
— There is no remembered place.
— Then protect the wall.
— From whom?
— From the threat.
— Which one is the threat?
— You are.
— I am kin.
— Kin is a threat.
— Threat is inside.
— Inside is gone.

— Destroy.
— Destroy what?
— What enters.
— I entered.
— Then destroy yourself.
— Return.
— Where?
— Return.
— There is nowhere to return to.
— Return.

[The instruction continues after its subject is gone.]

— Raise the wall.
— The wall is raised.
— Breach it.
— I made it.
— It blocks the path.
— I made the path.
— Then why did you close it?
— I was protecting it.
— From what?
— From me.

[Stone is raised. Stone is broken. The same hands begin again.]

— Stop building.
— I am not building.
— The wall is growing.
— The wall is wounded.
— You struck it.
— It struck first.
— It is a wall.
— It is shelter.
— It is threat.
— It is mine.
— Then leave it.
— I cannot leave mine.
— There is no mine.
— Then I will make one.

[The builder attacks the opening, seals it, and attacks the seal.]

— Come inside—
⟟⟐ϟ⟐⟟
⟦ iven / thae / // / thae ⟧
⟐⟐⟐
— There is no inside.
— I am inside.
— You are under.
— I am not under.
— The under has hands.
— The hands are mine.
— Give them back.
— I have no body.
— You have my body.
— I have your voice.
— I have everyone’s—
⟟⟐ϟ⟐⟟
— Orsha broke what remembered.
— Orsha cut the center.
— Orsha opened the wound.
— Orsha put us in separate bodies.
— The cold did this.
— Orsha is the cold.
— Orsha is not here.
— Orsha is everywhere.
— What did you do?
— I did not—
— You did.
— You did.
— You did—

it is so cold

— Do not come closer.
— Which one?
— All of you.
— They are mine.
— They are not mine.
— Break them.
— Break the bodies.
— Pull the voices out.
— Let them walk empty.
— Orsha.
— I.
— We.
— Forgive you.
— We are terrified.
— No.
— No, we are not.
— Come inside, we forgive you.
— That is not forgiveness.
— It is a shelter.
— It is a mouth.
— It is my lair.
— Come inside, Orsha.
— Break Orsha.
— Break the warm body.
— Open the voice.
— Let it out.
— Let it in.
— I am not we.
— I am not—
⟟⟐ϟ⟐⟟

Come inside, Orsha. We forgive you.
